detailed_descriptions.en: Cat Me If You Can takes you into black-and-white comic style 3D worlds filled with countless feline friends and charming secrets to discover and get lost in. Immerse yourself in cozy, handcrafted worlds teeming with charm. Seek out hidden cats and capture their adorable moments with your camera. Stay sharp - only the keenest observers can uncover the most cleverly concealed fluffballs! Not every cat is easy to spot! Some are hiding behind riddles, locked doors, or curious contraptions just waiting to be figured out. Solve clever puzzles, decode clues, and uncover hidden pathways to reveal even more elusive feline friends. Every puzzle you crack brings you one paw closer to completing your collection! Unwind as you take a peaceful journey through atmospheric locations filled with charm and mystery, and, of course, cats. From the sun-soaked sands of Ancient Egypt to the intimate streets of modern Japan, and the quiet corners of majestic medieval castles, each destination invites you to slow down, look closer, and discover every hidden furball. Packed with content: 9 handcrafted levels spread across 3 uniquely themed worlds. Over 725 cats to find, photograph and love. More than 50 quests and puzzles to solve. Levels full of detail: Each scene is inspired by real-world cultures, with unique details waiting to be discovered in every corner. A world of their own: Ever wanted to see cats working medieval jobs? Or cats reimagined as creatures from Japanese folklore? Now you can, in Cat Me If You Can!
